title: Rashtrapati Nilayam Souvenir Shop
subtitle: RARE PLANET Retail Store Design – Secunderabad
description: Retail interior design for the RARE PLANET souvenir shop at Rashtrapati Nilayam, Secunderabad, inaugurated by the Hon'ble President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu, in December 2024.
body:
ADS Creative Space designed the interior of the RARE PLANET souvenir shop at Rashtrapati Nilayam, Secunderabad, the President of India's southern retreat. The store was inaugurated by the Hon'ble President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu, in December 2024.

The compact store pairs a full-height glass shopfront and a backlit line-art fascia with light timber shelving and warm concealed lighting, creating a clear, flexible display for souvenirs within a heritage setting.
features.0.title: Inaugurated by the President of India
features.0.text: The store was inaugurated by the Hon'ble President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu, in December 2024 at Rashtrapati Nilayam, the President's southern retreat. ADS Creative Space provided the interior design.
features.1.title: A Clear, Inviting Shopfront
features.1.text: A full-height glass shopfront opens the store to the visitor corridor. A backlit fascia carries a line drawing of Rashtrapati Nilayam above the RARE PLANET name, and a glass display unit at the entrance introduces the range.
features.2.title: A Flexible Display System
features.2.text: Light timber shelving within slim white frames, with warm concealed lighting along each shelf, displays handcrafted souvenirs, clocks, ceramics and stationery, and can be rearranged as the collection changes.
features.3.title: Design Concept
features.3.text: The early concept explored a warmer, gallery-like store with a timber fascia, dark display racks and track lighting. This is a design render; the merchandise was added digitally for visualisation.
